description: Bladebro MCP server (bladebro mcp, stdio): five tools act, see, state, run, vision; the operation is an argument.

configure.workaround: No per-call configuration. Set the server environment before the MCP server starts (see recording.env and the driver notes): BLADE_HEADLESS=1, BLADE_PACE=off, BLADE_NO_WARMING=1, BLADE_HOME=<scratch dir>. Screenshot directory: the path printed by the screenshot call is used as is. Video directory: BLADE_RECORD=<absolute dir>.

viewport.note: dpr, mobile and reset=true are extra args

observe.note: mode=content for page text, outline for headings only

click.note: address by ref, text, label or selector

dialog.note: arm before the action that opens the dialog

diff.note: partial: model delta since the last capture, not a two-snapshot diff

screenshot.note: returns the image inline and prints the saved PNG path; there is no filename argument. Demo: pass the printed path to demo-check register-shot (artifact_index register)

screenshot_get.workaround: Not needed: the vision call returns the image in its own result. To re-read a saved shot, Read the PNG path it printed.

screenshot_delete.workaround: Delete the printed PNG path with the shell (rm).

screenshots.workaround: List the artifact directory with the shell (ls); the vision call prints each path.

screencast_start.note: needs BLADE_RECORD and ffmpeg; format and fps come from recording.env

screencast_stop.note: returns path, bytes, duration. Demo: pass the printed path to demo-check register-video (artifact_index register)

screencast_delete.workaround: Delete the printed video path with the shell (rm).

screencasts.workaround: List the recording directory (BLADE_RECORD) with the shell (ls).

set_headers.workaround: No equivalent. Route the app through an HTTP proxy that adds the header and start the MCP server with BLADE_PROXY, or authenticate with set_cookies / a stored session (state save/load).

drag.workaround: No equivalent. Use evaluate to dispatch pointer events on the source and target, or test the same outcome through the keyboard or the app's own controls.

dev_serve.workaround: Start the project's dev server with its stack.services launch command (shell), not through the driver.

dev_audit.note: accessibility and layout findings: contrast, names, overflow, small targets, broken links

dev_inject.workaround: Use evaluate to run the injected script in the page.

instance_launch.workaround: One daemon per BLADE_HOME: start a separate MCP server with its own BLADE_HOME for a second browser.

instance_kill.workaround: Stop the daemon with the shell (bladebro stop).

instance_list.workaround: No equivalent; the daemon is one per BLADE_HOME.
